api_exact.description: Programmatic API preserves exact destination unless snapping explicitly enabled

arrival.description: Player actually arrives at snapped center line

bend_path.description: Planned path includes road bends rather than an off-road diagonal

bend_trajectory.description: Actual physics trajectory stays on centerline and reaches the corner before turning; deviation=0.0000

blocked_centerline.description: A road through a mountain is rejected even when ordinary Navigation can detour to its end

branch_route.description: Changing roads follows the main/south junction and all branch bends

branch_trajectory.description: Actual movement across the shared junction stays on road centers

closest_road.description: Nearest south-road segment selected across road registry

endpoint.description: Projection clamps beyond the last endpoint

entry_arrival.description: Off-road connector joins road and arrives on exact center

entry_connector.description: Off-road approach uses Navigation to enter nearest center without teleporting

intent.description: Road ground command retains selected location intent

interior_junction.description: Crossings split segment interiors into proper road junctions

invalid_raw.description: Road snapping rejects obstacle and exterior raw clicks

invalid_snapped.description: Unreachable snapped center line is rejected instead of falling back or bypassing obstacles

location_exact.description: Location commands preserve exact interaction points without road snapping

mouse_snap.description: Real viewport ground click snaps target, marker and actual navigation path

near_road.description: Ground near the road snaps within configurable margin

projection.description: Click within road width projects to nearest segment center

registry.description: Demo registers main and south center lines

route_cancel.description: Cancel clears centerline waypoints and path display

route_pause.description: Pause/resume retains centerline route and progresses after resume

route_retarget.description: New road command replaces old route, including reverse travel

speed_areas.description: Real Area2D contacts accelerate road movement, Mud overrides and exit restores base speed

translated_map.description: Road projection remains correct in translated independent map instances
